title: Relieve fuel pressure, disconnect fuel lines, harness and grounds

notices.text: Relieve rail pressure before opening any fuel fitting, and plug both lines immediately — the 996 will dribble a surprising amount. The main engine harness plug sits on the left side of the engine; release the lever slowly, the connector body is brittle with age. Do not forget the two engine ground straps — a missed ground causes maddening no-start diagnostics later.

steps.text: Relieve fuel pressure, disconnect fuel lines, harness and grounds.
